notes.title: Progress Update Week 2
notes.content:
Progress Update
Hi there, I wanted to bring you news of what we have been up to since the release just over a week ago. We worked long and hard to bolt in as many of the mechanics of the game before the release. Knowing we were going 'Early Access' gave us some leeway though on expanding the Galaxy and its content.

Our early tester group seems to have nailed down all the 'major' bugs and issues that might otherwise have plagued an early access release, so thanks, guys! Much appreciated...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/aff98f6e54b7d601d9f6a0b15425ea8c6a9bc3a2.jpg

So since release, we have been working on a number of main elements. The largest of these has been nailing down the 'Phoenix Galaxy'. It comprises some 60+ systems (on the office wall here) and we have been working on adding more of these to the development game as we can.

I suspect come the weekend we will be in a position to push out this new build to the Live Early access for you to enjoy.

Understanding Factions
Hannon has a Galaxy made up of Four Main Factions. These Factions control large swathes of the game's systems.  Captain Hannon finds himself initially stuck in the Feris system which is part of the Galactic Federation. Depending on which viewpoint you want to stand on these can be classified as 'Good Guys'. 

You can read the partially 'recovered history' in the game via the Galactic Database. But to cut a long story short the Melar race sponsored Humanity into the Galactic Federation. Of course, being Human we eventually had enough of being told what to do and split off and formed our own Faction called the Colonial Union.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/f31010a7563e490e88b18c02e67d7e93b6f100cf.jpg

The other major Factions that control the space lanes are the Galactic Federation, Common Wealth of planets and the Foreen Alliance.

On the scale of friendliest to scary space Monsters, you can think of the Gal-Fed and C.O.P as our allies. The Foreen Alliance on the other hand... Well, let's just say they 'like' Humans...

Preferably served on a platter with other delicacies.

So designing and bringing these systems and factions to life is our overall task at the moment. But, this last week we have looked at expanding the current systems to connect up from Gal-Fed territory to the Colonial Union and the Commonwealth of planets.

We will be populating these new systems with more Asteroid Fields, Planets and of course starbases. 

The next phase will be the additions of lots more NPC's and expanding the central mission line for those playing it.

Expanding Cargo Systems
Currently, you only have access to the single Ashar cargo freight company. These are limited cargo runs based on the current in-game systems available to you. As we expand the Galaxy with new systems this will exponentially grow. Giving you access to a wide network of cargo missions to earn credits and faction. Also giving you access to more freight companies.

We are also looking at upgrading / changing how freight missions are offered and taken then displayed. More on that when we get it nailed down.

Internal location Maps
I've been looking into the possibility of creating maps for the locations in-game, certainly, in space, it would be handy to know at a glance where the Jump Gates and planets are. After all there is a lot of pirates out there with your name on their hit list...  I'll get back to you on this one.

Bug Tracking
We have also been busy fixing the small issues or quirks that the beta testers are reporting to us. If you have a copy of Hannon don't forget the whole point of Early Access (for us) is to get feedback and suggestions so please feel free to take part in our community forums.

Looking for Participation
Do you have a creative flair when it comes to writing, long or short prose? We are in need of the communities support. There are plenty of things that we need to pad out and add to in the game, so we thought why not give the community the chance to feed into that, (if they want).

Live and play in a Galaxy 'you' helped create!

Drop us a line or check out the forums for posts on these topics and join in.

I'm back off to the pit of creation.... have fun folks

Coops

notes.title: Release Day - Early Access Open
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/38309a91a3557d57d92ec58ff0bf4afc61860d15.jpg

Release Day
So we finally reach 'Release Day' here on steams Early Access.  Why early access? Well, you could read the Early Access Steam FAQ above on this page, but in a nutshell, the game is designed and created by 2 guys in the very definition of indie development.

We need support to get the project to the next level and beyond. We have created a fully functioning and playable 'Classic ARPG', but want to make it so much more. So we are going down the Early Access path and allowing YOU the player to give feedback and help in making the game a hit.

We fully intend to expand and create masses more content to the game, and with your support, we can do this faster and smarter. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/f31010a7563e490e88b18c02e67d7e93b6f100cf.jpg

What to Expect
Hannon is a classic style ARPG. It's not a AAA game, but it makes up for it in its envisioned futuristic scope. It has a central plot running through it with expanded sandbox potential bursting at the seams. 

Each major plot-line will be released in sections, but the Phoenix Galaxy will continue to grow with constant updates and releases. More Systems, more NPC's, more Bad Guys and Loots. Over time the Galaxy will take place and the storyline plots and overall history already laid out will gel.

You can expect the game to be in early access until the full galaxy has been deployed and all the systems and locations are fully developed. At that point, we will start the task of adding more and more population, storyline and quests.

We have been working with several artists and early access will ensure we can continue to expand the artwork and continue the  'feel' of the game with more diverse Biomes and locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/4003fd8bbe5021f9d4e6c8042973c945135d2b0f.jpg

Bugs & Resets?
Will there be Bugs, sure I wouldn't bet against there being issues that we have not yet found, but that's another reason for the Early Access process. With your help and feedback, we can nail them down and squash them early on. We will listen and work to solve them best we can as the game progresses.

Will there be a reset? Hard to say. That one really depends on a few key factors. Initially, the game will be released with a multi save function allowing for up to 24 saves. This is likely to be altered as time goes on but I would be remiss to say flatly no. So let's go with a soft yes and no one will be too surprised if a reset is required.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/c52f7b8af6ab398258e5e760f29e8c265fdce82e.jpg

Single Player Only?
Essentially Hannon is a single-player game. But, it all takes place in the Phoenix Galaxy. Everyone is playing in the same space, so we hope (Early access support permitting) to migrate systems within the game over to an 'Online Connected' system.

Imagine being able to visit NPC's whose stocks and prices are related to what your fellow players are doing. Imagine a Galactic Buyers Market, somewhere to visit and place contracts for items you need but can't find or don't want to farm over time.

Game elements, like what Factions are doing in-game and which faction controls which systems and planets, all moulded by each players actions coming together as a whole to affect the outcomes.

We have a lot of hopes and ideas for a Multi connected Galaxy with all of YOU playing within it. The key is support and Early access gets us that opportunity.

Feedback, Community & Contribution
We have been creating online games for well over a decade now and one thing we like to pride ourselves on is our community spirit. We try to listen to all constructive feedback and take note.

We welcome 'contribution'. If you have a flair for the creative get in touch. Fancy seeing your thoughts and humorous comments coming from Hannon and Zed, or the NPC's that make up the Phoenix Galaxy - we have plans for that!

Finally...
Yes, it's release day, but for us, this is just the beginning of a very long journey. We hope with your support we will be here for many years building a Sci-Fi universe that you are still coming back to year on year.

If you have purchased Hannon, thank you! Your support will make all the difference!

notes.title: Hannon Update for Internal Build 1.29
notes.content:
It's been a busy few weeks. I've been ironing out lots of small 'kinks and quirks' our early Beta Testers have been locating (thanks guys). Mean while I've also been hammering away at some of the core sections of the game adding in more balance and ironing out things like NPC Mission Formats and how we are going to work with the 'dissemination' of information in Hannon.

So Read on....

Penalty on Death
Hannon doesn't have a 'Perma Death', no hard reset or start again. But we do have a Penalty on character or ship Incapacitation. 

At Zero HP your classified as incapacitated and emergency services are called. In the case of you 'personally' you're transferred back to the nearest medical bay (in that system). Insurance covers medical bills but you will likely incur a financial cost for the retrieval. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/9420e5fcc2a0a60053c02a5bdaa6c4cd8615c947.jpg

The same goes for the Shuttle. Loosing a shuttle is an unhealthy endeavor and will again incur a cost for the issue of a new shuttle. Your insurance (Taken out by ZED) will cover most of these bills but you will find yourself subject to a cost for both activities. 

But...

Being incapacitated and dragged back to a medical bay has a much wider reaching impact. You will LOSE any and all resources / commodities on your ship and in your pockets. 

You won't loose things like weapons, armour or anything on your action bar (med kits etc) but you will loose all those loots since your last visit to the Commercial Store. So it's  really important you get into the hang of swinging by the C.S and dropping off what you can't afford to loose!

Jump Fuel Change
Last post I stated that I'd added Jump Fuel to the Game. This is required to use the Jump Gates in Hannon to get from System to System. It bothered me using a 'regenerates over time' model. I've used this in my current browser games and whilst it works I wanted something a little more 'involved'. So I've made some modifications this week and we now have an new method on how you  'Get Jump Fuel'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/122a9f023b9f673a74a900c2be5f0c95b041dd61.jpg

In game you will find the Novastone Asteroids. These green suckers can be mined and refined by visiting an ARK Refinery. Refining Novastone gives you 'Jump Fuel Canisters'. This is Jump fuel compressed in to canisters to make it easy for you to carry around and store. 

You will get roughly 3 units of Jump Fuel Canister for each Novastone unit refined. (Plus the chance of other elements) during the refining process. Jump Fuel Canisters can then be kept in your hold or stored in the Commercial Store. 

Remember I spoke about adding in 'Penalty on Death'. So sure, keep some on you, but seeing you had to mine it then refine it, wouldn't it be a shame to loose it?

So remember to store some in your Commercial Store...

Using Jump Fuel
Now that we have removed the 'regenerate' over time fuel ticker you will need to 'Use' the Jump Fuel Canisters yourself you top up your Jump Engines when you need it. You can do this now via your tool bar. If you have Jump Fuel Canisters they will appear on your bar and you can decompress the Jump Fuel into your Jump Engine.

You will get a 10:1 ratio for each unit of Jump Fuel Canister you use. So later when you start jumping around the Galaxy you will need to start to 'pencil in' your Jump Fuel costs, requirements and ensure you have enough.

We will ensure each system has an ARK refinery, but leave mining the Novastone and refining it down to you :)

Ship Loots
I have started to expand the dissemination of the new Salvage loots in to the loot tables for the bad guy ships you will run across in Hannon. As you delve deeper into the Phoenix Galaxy the Pirates will get tougher and the loot more diverse. 

So, start taking note of what drops from whom and where. You will be needing these loots, either directly or Salvaged for NPC missions. 

NPC Deployment Begins
I wanted to take some time to pan out how I was going to do the NPC mission systems. I think I'm happy with the way they work and I have started rolling out new NPC's. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/2c4c54669f42ce63dd7d020cb530f38177106f91.jpg

At the moment I'm adding them to the planets and stations in Feris, but as the development progresses I will start ramping up their deployment and You'll find them all over the Phoenix Galaxy. These NPC's will want pretty much anything and everything. So again make good use of the Commercial Stores to start stock piling, as you never know when an NPC is going to ask for the items you just sold off!

Galactic Database
Whilst it's not yet in game, I'm working on adding a Galactic Database to the game. This will allow us to add a rich back stop to pretty much everything in game. This saves us having to try and impart this information in an 'in your face' way and allows for a much richer and deeper lore for the game over time.

Lots of Balancing and content work this coming week along with a boat load more NPC's so I'm off to kick start that!

Coops

notes.title: More Changes & Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/bc6157ba04c630dd80802fcb052050313a3d2a8e.png

Commercial Storage Services
Been a real busy week with many additions and changes to Hannon. But one that really will make Hannon work better over time is the addition of the Commercial Storage Services. It's taken me a few days to nail down how I wanted it to work and to ensure that we could make it accessible throughout sections of the Phoenix Galaxy, but its now in...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/5cf1c1a52f0243c10ff3e04caa7a67a3f9105306.png

The Commercial Store Services (C.S.S) allows for you to store items (up to 5,000) into the companies depot and access them at any other terminal any where in the Galaxy. This means no lugging around 100's of items you won't need for ages, plus means you won't LOSE them should you get injured on a planet, or get your Shuttle busted up and lost. (Yup that's coming to Hannon shortly Penalty on Death).

The Terminals are dotted around the Galaxy and the service is FREE. Funded by those kind folks at the Galactic Federation (Gal-Fed). You will be able to deposit and retrieve items from the General Inventory, resources and salvage sections of your store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/6df0711d1041073029f550125e65652ddc57d225.png

A.R.K Refining Service
Taken me a while but the A.R.K Refining Service is now fully working in game. I have deployed  their terminals in key locations in the current Galaxy. This will of course increase over time as we expand the Phoenix Galaxy.

You can refine any of the Asteroid resources you have mined in to further resources. The refining process will indicate which resources can 'possibly' be refined from the target ore. This is by no means a guarantee though, and often you may only get 1 or the other, or a few of the sought after refined resources. 

On the bright side, there is no cost involved. The A.R.K Refining services takes a small modicum of the refined possible resources as payment.  I will leave it up to you to figure out which Ore gives the best results for the numerous resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/ae9912de20492dce0e892afd7089189e1d7cdbae.png

Jump Fuel
One of the things I wanted to bring in before release was Jump Fuel. This is fuel required to navigate between the stars when using the Jump Gates. Your Ship generates Jump Fuel over time and this fuel is required (along with a small credit surcharge) to use the Jump Gate Network.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/5437bf8a0af5aafd6899558bc3358118a52b1407.png

When in your Combat Shuttle you will see a Green bar beneath your HP, Energy bars. As I say this regenerates slow over time. If you have enough, the jump gate operator will line you up and fire you off to the next System. Insufficient fuel or credits and you'll be told. This means now that we have another element of cost involved in travel. 

Therefore when taking Missions say for instance for a Freight company like Ashar or Wesbec, you will need to take in to consideration fuel and credit costs to utilise the network of gates to your destination.

General Fixes & Edits
I've also been hammering away at lots and lots of minor edits and fixes thanks to our diligent testers. Special thanks to The Wolf, Madmaxxx, Ram2000 and of course SMO Valadorn. I will continue to add content and fix issues as they appear as much as possible until we are ready to go to release.

notes.title: Resources Expanded
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/942b6a8d44316cb87e8800304a7fa5c263c611b2.jpg

I've spent the last week working on bulking out the resource systems in Hannon.  I have nailed it down to Four Categories so far. Each one will be accessible to all players in game and is likely to grow over time as we add more systems.

Asteroids
Hannon has many 'Asteroid Fields' and these will grow as the game expands. But interspersed in these fields you will find specific 'Mineable Asteroids'. These are the first form of resource gathering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/99e5accc7df8920d02c9cfab70e9508a790c623a.jpg

I have created Sixteen base Asteroids for mining. These are from the lowly more common types through to the more rare and hard to locate ones. These can be currently mined using a variety of weapons but the most economical being the use of a Mining Laser! Ores are tractored in directly and stored in your Ships Hold.

Refined Resources
Next up is the Refined Resources. We now have Refining terminals dotted around the current Galaxy. These are A.R.K Refining Terminals. They are free to use but they will take a % of your refined resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/ad84b330c1972a4af2de8ab5b6e4504dfca0f1b4.jpg

I have so far created Eighteen refined resources. These come from the Asteroids and each asteroid can be broken down in to a 'possible' mixture of these refined resources. The how and what and why I will leave you to discover. ːsteamfacepalmː

Salvage Loot
Salvage Loot is different from 'normal loot' in that it can be 'Salvaged' in to basic crafting resources. The loot is commonly located when killing ships, robots, AI and the many creatures in Phoenix Galaxy. So far we have 28 types of this Salvage Loot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/3f31e9ebe3293cad077efc09986dab771d653851.jpg

Each player can process their own Salvage direct from the ships interface. Simply bring up the Salvage interface see what can be salvaged and the system will indicate what 'Might' be possible to salvage from it. 

Crafting Resources
These are the base resources used for future crafting and will form the back bone of any crafting in game. These resources are from the Salvage process above. Expect this list to grow as we add more planets and systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36740355/cce33d8bd45ec9b84c95c9c856b0799f951d3842.jpg

All the Resources systems above will be tied in to the Faction based NPC missions and story line quests. Some will be simply 'required' others may need them crafting in to XYZ items and so on, but they will all have a use in the Phoenix Galaxy.
